stories.new_fact: AP reported October annual inflation at 4 percent, up from 3.7 percent, with officials debating faster versus gradual further hikes.

stories.new_fact: Northern Trust and Microsoft disclosed an agent that standardizes historical transaction data in client onboarding, reporting time and first-pass-quality results.
stories.new_takeaway: A bounded onboarding conversion can be evaluated against analyst reference output and its exception queue rather than a generalized automation promise.
stories.why_now: The November 9 production deployment adds a different lane-four workflow with measured company-reported evidence.
stories.previous_coverage: The prior seven used AI access controls, a framework, and a shared development environment, not this onboarding deployment.
stories.uncertainty: The metrics come from a joint company/vendor release, the controlled F1 test used seven cases, and broader exception data are not published.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI launched Businesses in ChatGPT beta, including Business Hub and Business Agents for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses.
stories.new_takeaway: A new agent surface changes business-customer interaction availability, but needs local answer-quality and escalation evidence before consequential use.
stories.why_now: The product announcement is dated November 10.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous seven did not cover this launch or its separate business-agent interaction surface.
stories.uncertainty: OpenAI does not disclose answer accuracy, conversion, complaint, refund, latency, or safety outcomes, and eligibility is limited.
stories.watch: Eligibility expansion, quality evidence, customer outcomes, and error or complaint reporting.
